title: Tests keep their fixture folders under the repository's target/ instead of the system temp folder
outcome: Tests keep their fixture folders under the repository's target/ instead of the system temp folder
acceptance: Every recursive delete in test support resolves its target and refuses one outside the repository's target/ directory, and a test proves the refusal
The full gate passes with no new folder left under the system temp folder's engram/ directory
scripts/test-temp.mjs and src/test_support.rs create and delete fixture folders only under the repository's target/ directory, never under the system temp folder

completion.summary:
Landed as 3c61054 on origin/master and installed as build d131df37.
- Rust and Node test fixtures live in this checkout's target/tmp/engram, one run-<pid>-<random> directory per run, never in the system Temp.
- Every recursive delete in test support goes through one guard per runtime, anchored to target/tmp/engram. It refuses paths outside the root, roots outside the anchor, and any symlink or junction from target/ down, and it re-checks before each attempt. A refusal is never retried. The empty-run removal is non-recursive and guarded, and Rust skips it after a refusal.
- Setup refuses a linked target/ or target/tmp before creating anything, and Git in a fixture stops at the run root. Test junctions are created by Node with no shell.
- The root-probe DACL restore check ignores only the auto-inherited flag, which differs between the checkout and the Temp chain.
- Round-9 full gate passed; the Codex and Claude reviews were clean after nine rounds.
- The system Temp\engram gained nothing across the gate.
- Independent Codex evaluation: 3/3 criteria pass.
